sozzle.definition:
v. t. To splash or wet carelessly; as, to sozzle the feet in
   water.
v. t. To heap up in confusion.
n. One who spills water or other liquids carelessly;
   specifically, a sluttish woman.
n. A mass, or heap, confusedly mingled.
sozzle.translation:
vt. 泼水冲洗; 使喝醉
vi. 闲荡；懒洋洋地倚靠
